record.source_closeout_reference: Authored during the mission in the Claude Code session executing the sponsor-approved four-mission strengthening plan; commit hash to be recorded at commit time

mission.objective: Create an advisory regulatory crosswalk mapping V3 artifacts to EU AI Act Article 14/26 and ISO/IEC 42001 themes, with explicit no-compliance-claim status, every row marked for human review per the PO role definition, and the Article 26 six-month log-retention duty named as a design consideration; register the lane as V3-ANCHOR-010.

envelope.reference: Sponsor instruction in the Claude Code conversation approving execution of steps 1-4 of the strengthening plan, with step 3 covering the regulatory crosswalk
envelope.not_created_reason: Bounded docs-only change executed from a direct thread-local sponsor instruction; this shadow record was authored during the mission.

forbidden_scope: no compliance, conformity, or certification claims
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push after approval
fallback_triggers: scope expands beyond the crosswalk doc, registry row, and README scope bullet
any wording reads as a compliance, conformity, or certification claim
an assertion loses its marked-for-human-review status
verification reports an unresolved advisory finding

verification.summary: Advisory lint, NL pilot, knowledge lint, and diff whitespace checks passed on the first run after the edits; mission-record lint run after this record was authored.

notes: Docs-only advisory crosswalk with no new dependencies or code paths.
Every correspondence row is marked for human review and the document names what it does not establish, satisfying the PO role constraint on regulatory assertions.
Regulatory dates (2026-08-02 application, six-month log retention) were verified against current EU AI Act sources during the planning conversation that preceded this mission.
Scope stayed inside the crosswalk doc, registry row, and README scope bullet.
No compliance claim, classification opinion, or external-use approval was added.

friction_notes: The crosswalk cites regulation themes from secondary research rather than clause-by-clause legal text review; the named human/legal review follow-up is load-bearing before any external use.
Several correspondence rows depend on artifacts created earlier the same day (mutable harness state, skill provenance), so the mapping is fresher than the evidence behind those artifacts.
false_positive_notes: No advisory findings were raised on this change.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass; the advisory lints do not check regulatory accuracy, which is why the human-review marker is required.

phase2_design_signals: A crosswalk that maps artifact to regulatory theme while explicitly refusing classification and compliance claims converts governance discipline into reviewable external-facing material at near-zero risk.
The Article 26 six-month retention duty was the only concrete schema-adjacent obligation surfaced; it belongs in the mission-record design as a retention statement.
Regulatory mapping rows age with both the regulation and the artifacts; the periodic re-check follow-up should ride on existing doc-consistency missions rather than a new process.
